latestVersion.changelog:
Codex CN Bridge Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables OpenAI Codex CLI to use Chinese mainland AI models (Aliyun Qwen, Kimi, GLM, default Baichuan Coding Plan).
- Translates OpenAI API calls to domestic chat APIs.
- Supports multiple models: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen-Coder-Plus, Qwen3-Max, Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5.
- One-click setup with automatic Codex configuration; supports both `.env` files and environment variables.
- Includes model switching, status checking, and service control commands.
